plan.title: RFQ enters evaluation after bidding closes

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow required for this RFQ.
Configure the single-stage event as an RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template before adding products.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet, including the requested delivery location where required.
Set and commit the 15-minute bidding duration; the unavailable evaluation-duration setting is the stated coverage gap.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors for Vendor A and Vendor B bidding.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Have the first invited vendor submit the quote of 100.
Confirm the first vendor's quote was accepted.
Have the second invited vendor submit the quote of 90.
Confirm the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Wait for the 15-minute bidding window to end rather than force-ending it.
Assert that the stage badge changed from Live to the evaluation status.
Assert that the evaluation end-time/countdown information is displayed.
